severityRationale:
Low CONFIRMED, and tagged faithfulness: true. Under Law 2 this is a spec-conformance finding and routes to spec-conformance.md as label F-01. It must NOT be folded into the QA/gas bundle - that routing rule is independent of the severity label and is the explicit anti-burial provision.

SEVERITY. There is no asset at risk and no protocol function or availability impact: the reverted code is local rehearsal scaffolding on a throwaway chain. What was lost is the AUTHORISATION RECORD. Story 079 sits in complete/ with checklist items 536-541 mandating the Phase 7.6 rehearsal; e6eded0 - untagged, storyless - deletes it while satisfying only item 540 and leaving items 533-535 and 542 intact. That selectivity is what makes it a targeted reversal rather than an oversight, and it is what makes the finding stronger than the two prior un-storied-work entries. The negative claim is properly established rather than asserted: an exhaustive glob of the whole ~/code/product-owner/stories/phStaging2 tree (all states, all sprint folders, 82 files, topping out at 081) plus a full-tree grep for slim/trim/retire-the-rehearsal/remove-old-cutover returns zero hits. That is the Law-2 standard - the story genuinely does not exist, not 'the story is unavailable'.

LAW-3 CHARACTERISATION, ENDORSED: this is a FOOTGUN, not a reckless-admin mistake and not a malicious-owner vector. The test is whether a competent, non-malicious owner would be surprised by the consequence - and here the consequence is that an accepted, fix-pending audit remediation silently went live again. The source comments make a coherent case that the deleted rehearsals are obsolete; the defect is that the judgement is UNREVIEWABLE as filed. Surprise ⇒ footgun ⇒ report.

PRIORITY 2, immediately behind CAND-03. F-01 is the authorisation gap that PERMITTED the regression, and the two are deliberately not collapsed: F-01 stands even if eda17642 is later judged genuinely obsolete, and CAND-03 stands even if a story is written tomorrow. The pattern disclosure is ENDORSED and must be carried into the report rather than triaged away: this is the THIRD run in four to raise an un-storied-work finding on this entry point (run-26 Q-01 1c989373, run-28 F-03 da94d1ba, now run-30 F-01). Three occurrences is a process signal about how work lands on `dev`, and it should be weighed as a pattern, not as three isolated Lows. That recurrence is a priority argument, not a severity argument - it does not make any single instance Medium.
